name: 虚词 DNA 指纹图谱图 (Function Word Profiling)
description: 分析虚词（冠词、介词、连词、代词）在潜意识深处的分布规律。这些虚词是人类作者绝对无法主观控制的“词汇生物识别指纹”。
algorithm: 封闭词类拓扑分布 & Burrows's Delta 算法分析
mechanism: While content words (nouns, verbs, adjectives) dictate *what* a text is about, function words (the, of, and, in, a) dictate *how* it is cognitively structured. Function words constitute nearly 50% of the English language, yet humans use them almost entirely subconsciously. Decades of computational stylometry (authorship attribution) have proven that every human has a unique, highly stable mathematical fingerprint based on the frequencies and ratios of these 'invisible' words. AI models, however, are an amalgamation of billions of authors. Rather than possessing a singular, stable human fingerprint, an LLM outputs an overwhelmingly generic, perfectly averaged 'statistical ghost' distribution. This method utilizes Burrows's Delta metric to measure the relative frequencies of over 300 closed-class function words against an immense corpus of baseline human writing. If the function word distribution achieves a near-perfect 'vanilla' statistical mean—lacking the idiosyncratic, slightly asymmetrical function word ratios that organically occur even in professional human writing—the text is flagged as a machine-generated synthesis.
useCase: 这是语言法医学中测定作者身份的“黄金标准”。尤其是在审计那些极其严肃、毫无废话的学术文献或法律简报时（因为这些文体里本来就没有脏话、情绪和俚语可以抓），虚词指纹是唯一的照妖镜。
strengths:
• 真正的硬核防作弊：不管是人类黑客想自己洗稿，还是命令 AI“装作某个人写”，他们都绝无可能骗过这个探针。因为虚词的调用发生在大脑意识阈值之下，你根本意识不到自己在用它们。
• 不受题材限制的绝对稳定：不管是写《拖拉机维修手册》还是写《绝笔情书》，一个人的虚词指纹图谱是死死刻在基因里的，永远不会变。
• 背后有超过 30 经验证的、能够作为现实法庭呈堂证供的司法语言学研究作为终极背书。
limitations:
• 饿汉算法：必须吃够足够长的文本（通常至少要 300 词以上）才能画出有统计学意义的正态分布曲线，短文本直接罢工。
• 无法内斗：它很轻易抓出 AI，但由于现在所有先进的 LLM（如 Claude 和 GPT-4）在对齐训练后，都在向同一个“人类语言质心”靠拢，所以很难靠它来区分到底是谁家的 AI 写的。
• 强烈的语言壁垒：它必须死死绑定每一种语言特有的“封闭虚词词典”，因此给英语、西班牙语和日语建数学模型，必须完全推倒重来三次。
parameters:
雷达切片: 300+ 封闭类虚词强制接管 & Z-Score 标准化洗脱
定罪量表: Burrows's Delta 文体发散度 vs 纯种人类语言质心
行刑判决: 0-100 文体同质化 (算法强制平均) 定罪分数
accuracy: 顶层防线 — 80-88%（在长篇、多段落文本中）。它是目前用以区分“人类真实有机认知”和“统计学瞎聊机器”最可靠、在学术界最无可辩驳的重型核武器。

references.title: Burrows, J. F. (2002). Delta: A Measure of Stylistic Difference and Its Literary History. Literary and Linguistic Computing.
Kestemont, M. (2014). Function Words in Authorship Attribution: From Black Magic to Theory? EACL.

source: Burrows, J. F. (2002). Delta: A Measure of Stylistic Difference and Its Literary History. Literary and Linguistic Computing.; Kestemont, M. (2014). Function Words in Authorship Attribution: From Black Magic to Theory? EACL.
